verified: BYD officially unveiled the Whale at the 2026 Guangzhou Auto Show, describing it as the first MPV in its Ocean series and a 5.3-meter vehicle offered as both a battery-electric and a plug-in hybrid, according to CarNewsChina and Autoevolution; BYD's stated range figure is 900 km measured on China's CLTC test cycle, which Electrek converts to roughly 559 miles.
unconfirmed: the five-minute charging claim, which rests on BYD's own announcement with no published battery size, charger type, or starting charge level; whether the 900 km CLTC figure translates to comparable range under US EPA or European WLTP testing; and price, on-sale date, and availability outside China, none of which the reports provide.

verified: 据 CarNewsChina 和 autoevolution 报道，比亚迪在 2026 年广州车展上正式发布“Whale（鲸）”MPV。这是比亚迪海洋系列的首款 MPV，车长约 5.3 米，CLTC 工况续航 900 公里，并将提供纯电和插混两种动力版本。
unconfirmed: 559 英里（900 公里）是 CLTC 工况数据，并非 EPA 或 WLTP 实测值；Electrek 与 autoevolution 分别写作 559 英里和 560 英里，只是同一 900 公里数据的换算取整有差异。“五分钟充电”只是比亚迪方面的说法，报道未说明所需充电桩功率和电量区间，也没有第三方实测。价格、上市时间和交付安排均未公布。

titles.en: BYD debuts Whale minivan with claimed 900 km range and five-minute charging
titles.zh: 比亚迪旗舰纯电MPV“鲸”首发，宣称续航559英里、5分钟充电
